read.en: Alphabet edged up 0.4% on Nov 3 to $280.03, trading between $277.20 and $281.60. It is below all its averages, each falling: the 5-day ($289.5), 10-day ($306.4), 30-day ($332.4), 100-day ($344.0) and 200-day ($340.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($315.19), and RSI is 22, oversold.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月3日微涨 0.4%，收于 $280.03，盘中区间 $277.20–281.60。股价位于全部均线下方，且均线均在下行：5 日（$289.5）、10 日（$306.4）、30 日（$332.4）、100 日（$344.0）和 200 日（$340.1）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$315.19），RSI 为 22，处于超卖。

read.en: An inside day: the $276.9 support held at a $277.2 low and no written level broke. Resistance is $281.6–283.1 (Nov 3 and Oct 30 highs), then $287.0–289.5 (Nov 2 and Oct 29 highs, 5-day) and $294.1–296.3 (Mar 9 and Feb 17 lows). Support is $275.2–277.2, then $270.7–272.1 (52-week low) and $257.3. A close above $289.5 would target $294–296; below $270.7, $257.
